stem: (Select TWO.) Tallgrass Insurance installed its modules last quarter. A registry module has since published a newer release that its `version` constraint allows. Which two actions would move the installed modules forward?

choices.text: Running `terraform init` again with no extra flags
Running `terraform plan` before the next change
Running `terraform apply` on the unchanged configuration

rationale: The `-upgrade` flag on init updates already-installed modules, and `terraform get -update` checks downloaded modules for updates and downloads them. A plain re-run of init installs only modules added since the last run and does not change any already-installed module. Installing and provisioning are separate steps: init installs the module code, and plan and apply work with the modules already installed, so neither moves an installed module forward.
